findings.explanation: The controller decides which orders count toward customer lifetime value (excluding cancelled orders) and then sums their totals. That is business policy about order value and belongs in the application layer.

The controller decides which customers are ranked by lifetime value and omits zero-value customers, including the tie-breaking order. These are business ranking and eligibility rules that should be in an application service.
The controller decides that cancelled orders are excluded from units-by-SKU counts. That is a business definition of what counts as a sale, and it belongs in the application layer.
